completeness.why: All five provider handlers keep only their own bank lookup and call linkBankSyncAccount for the whole sequence (upgrade or insert with transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse, sync-event); the Pluggy file id and the Akahu event tables are passed as explicit arguments.

interface.why: fileId and eventTables are explicit parameters for real variations, but the GoCardless mask/official_name difference is not explicit: the helper infers it from whether the passed account object carries mask/official_name (official_name ?? name), so it depends on provider types happening to lack those fields; eventTables is also required at every call even though four of five pass the same value.

disguised_duplication.where: The five link sequences are removed in favour of linkBankSyncAccount; the small repeated institution object is part of the provider-specific bank lookup, not the shared logic.
